title: LEZ token and collection metadata (Logos Kit)
description: The JSON a LEZ TokenMetadata `uri` points to. LEZ v0.3 stores only {standard: Simple|Expanded, uri, creators, primary_sale_date} on chain and defines no JSON format, so Logos Kit defines this one. Fields follow the common NFT/ERC-1155/Metaplex names so existing tooling reads them. Metadata can't change after creation. See docs/design/token-list.md §4.

symbol.description: Fungible tokens: the ticker shown next to amounts.

decimals.description: Fungible tokens: display decimals (not stored on chain).

image.description: A bare Logos Storage CID (base58btc multibase, starts with `z`) or an https URL. PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF (first frame), up to 5 MB. SVG is not drawn.

attributes.description: Expanded standard only; ignored for Simple.

animation_url.description: Expanded standard only. Recorded and shown as a link; the wallet doesn't play it.
